title: City life or seaside life?
objective: Comparer deux modes de vie présentés dans des documents courts

steps.title: Warm-up: city or countryside?
steps.student_instruction: Vote: city, seaside or countryside? Give one reason.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Recueillir les raisons ; introduire quelques adjectifs (busy, quiet, expensive, exciting).

steps.title: Listening: Weather forecast
steps.student_instruction: Listen to the weather forecast. Note the weather and temperature in each region, then compare.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Faire comparer les régions (warmer than, the best weather) : premier contact avec le comparatif.

steps.title: Reading: Zoe and Kai
steps.student_instruction: Read the two texts. Find three differences and one similarity.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Lecture en deux colonnes ; repérer les adjectifs au comparatif dans les textes.

steps.title: Language focus and differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Learn the comparative rules, then do your A, B or C sheet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: -er than / more ... than / better, worse / as ... as. A : à trous ; B : phrases à partir du tableau ; C : paragraphe argumenté.

steps.title: Group presentation: Venn diagram
steps.student_instruction: In groups, compare two lifestyles in a Venn diagram and present three differences and one similarity.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Groupes de 3-4 ; chaque élève présente au moins une phrase comparative.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one comparison between your town and London.

sheets.student_content: Complete with the comparative: London is ___ (busy) than Newquay. Kai's school is ___ (small) than Zoe's. A flat in London is ___ (expensive) than a house in Cornwall. Life in Newquay is ___ (quiet).
Use the table (size, transport, prices, free time) to write five sentences comparing Zoe's and Kai's lives.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : London is bigger than Newquay. Zoe takes the Tube whereas Kai walks. London is more expensive. Kai has more time for surfing.

sheets.student_content: Which life would you choose, Zoe's or Kai's? Write 8-10 sentences with at least four comparatives and one 'as ... as'.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : comparatifs corrects (dont irréguliers), justification, nuance.

criteria: L'élève relève des différences dans deux documents

common_errors: more big au lieu de bigger
